description: MEMORY-FACULTY compose path vocabulary (graph data). Two RelationCue nodes map a CACHE/MEMOIZE concern's residual predicates to structural relations, and one ComposerCue routes the 'cache' relation head to the memory_faculty composer (domains/reflective_faculty._compose_memory_faculty). Checked: NO held RelationCue in relation_vocabulary.json carried 'cache'/'memoize' and NO held ComposerCue in composer_dispatch.json carried relation_head 'cache' before this change -- a genuine WALL (the composer could not reach a 'cache/memoize this consult' concern; note 'lookup' is avoided in the concern text because 'look' is a watch-cue keyword substring). This seed is NOT part of the minimal region_grouping/relation_vocabulary fixture the wall demo boots with, so the wall is reproducible at runtime (concern grounds to nothing without this seed); load_all_seeds picks it up alongside the curated seeds with no collision (priority 26, head 'cache' collides with nothing prior). The store_by_key cue names the memory-leaf op the composer chains under the cache: a serve-from-store Term reads the graph-resident hot tier (a HotStore bounded by the Rust memory faculty, memory_bound); the underlying lookup + the raw store put are the held-faculty call boundary (domains/memory_faculty_ops.py).
